title: Eventual native-pullback vanishing on a quasi-compact test scheme
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I\to\mathrm{CRing} a diagram, and c a limiting cone of R^{op} followed by Spec with affine vertex S. Let i\le k, f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i), and X_k=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_k) [def-pc-base-change]. Let t:W\to X_k be a test scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose composite b:W\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_k) is quasi-compact. Let F and G be finitely presented quasi-coherent modules on W [pqf-def-coherent] and \delta:F\to G. If the native module pullback of \delta along W\times_{X_k}X_S\to W is zero, then there is l\ge k such that its native pullback along W\times_{X_k}X_l\to W is zero. The maps X_S\to X_k and X_l\to X_k are overlapLimitMap and overlapStageMap [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. No Noetherianity, finite-presentation-of-f, or overlap-transition hypotheses are required.

proof.text: Put b equal to the composite of the test map t with the structural morphism to Spec(R_k). Pull the two modules and the map to the identity base change of b. Finite presentation and quasi-coherence are preserved by module pullback.

Paste the square defining the test-scheme limit pullback with isPullback_baseChangeMap. Its canonical isomorphism to the limit base change of b commutes with projection to W. Naturality of pullbackComp transports zero along this isomorphism. The tensor and native pullbacks are naturally isomorphic by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same pushforward, so their maps vanish simultaneously.

Apply finitePresentation_zero_map_descent to b with initial indices k and k. The source is finite type because it is finitely presented; the structural morphism b is quasi-compact by hypothesis. This gives a later stage l at which the tensor pullback of the transported map is zero.

At l repeat the pullback-pasting comparison and the tensor/native comparison. Naturality and cancellation of the invertible comparison components identify the resulting zero map with the native pullback of the original map along the test-scheme projection.

theorem finitePresentation_test_map_zero_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (k : I) (hik : i ≤ k) {W : Scheme.{u}}
    (t : W ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hik))))
    [QuasiCompact (t ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hik))))]
    (F G : W.Modules)
    (hF_fp : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hF_qc : F.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hG_fp : G.IsFinitePresentation) (hG_qc : G.IsQuasicoherent)
    (δ : F ⟶ G)
    (hδ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (pullback.fst t (overlapLimitMap R c f hik))).map δ = 0) :
    ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l),
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst t (overlapStageMap R f hik hkl))).map δ = 0
